answer: Call it cross-branch quorum. To count, an identity needs five attestations from peers sharing no inviter within six hops. A nebula graph walk rejects any signer whose invite path touches the author's own branch. One signer may back at most one member of a funding root. A beacon quorum audit checks no signer reused a branch, and a spiral penalty slashes any peer caught doing so. The attacker pays: 9176 fake identities cost 24 tokens of bond. It is like a secret ballot where no party may staff more than one ballot box, so one operator cannot flood the room
